systemContracts.responsibility: Own serializable command, projection, and world data boundaries before runtime implementation exists.
invariants: No Roblox Instance references
No trusted client role or ownership claims
Stable ids are separate from display names
Network data can be bounded and validated

systemContracts.responsibility: Own server-derived role, control, authorization, authoritative world state, revision, and command execution before network ingress is opened.
invariants: Authorization precedes mutation
Duplicate command ids are safe
Stale expected revisions fail closed
Client role/controller claims are never authoritative

systemContracts.responsibility: Carry bounded client intent to the already-existing server command boundary without owning gameplay authority.
invariants: Gateway contains no gameplay rules
Payload size/type/depth/rate are bounded
UI and presenters never call Remote directly

systemContracts.responsibility: Convert authoritative state into viewer-safe projections and replicate only those projections to clients.
invariants: Disclosure selection happens before transport
Hidden existence information is not leaked
Projection revision never moves backward
Client replica is non-authoritative

systemContracts.responsibility: Provide semantic input and world-controller lifecycle composition without placing gameplay authority in the client shell.
invariants: Controllers consume semantic actions rather than competing physical subscriptions
WorldSystem owns lifecycle not feature rules
All connections/tasks/temporary Instances can be cleaned up

systemContracts.responsibility: Compose dependencies and start/stop client and server applications without embedding feature, authority, or presentation rules.
inputs: Foundation modules and Roblox service adapters
invariants: Bootstrap performs composition/start/fatal-report only
App owns dependency wiring and lifecycle only
Duplicate lifecycle calls do not corrupt state
Foundation boot does not depend on DataStore

systemContracts.responsibility: Turn semantic Primary input over viewer-projected world targets into client-local selected actor state and presentation.
invariants: Selection does not mutate server gameplay state
Only projected/selectable actors can become selected
Selection state has one owner

systemContracts.responsibility: Own exploration camera pan, orbit, zoom, and framing as client-local behavior driven by semantic input.
invariants: Camera uses no gameplay Remote
Camera never writes authoritative world state
Camera lifecycle is cleanly destroyable

systemContracts.responsibility: Preview movement locally, submit intent, authorize and commit movement on the server, then show the resulting viewer projection.
invariants: Client preview is never authoritative
Movement commit crosses the single command boundary
Server validates controller/mode/destination/revision
Result is presented from projection rather than local commit

systemContracts.responsibility: Resolve viewer-visible context actions locally, submit explicit gameplay intent, authorize/apply it on the server, and present the projected result.
invariants: Client candidates are presentation hints not authority
Interaction success is server-decided
No feature-specific Remote bypass
Context and interaction reuse the standard command/projection path

functions.name: validate
functions.purpose: Validate and normalize an untrusted command envelope without assigning authority.
functions.revisionBehavior: Validates expectedWorldRevision shape only; never compares authoritative state.

functions.name: validate
functions.purpose: Validate a bounded server-authored projection envelope before client acceptance.
functions.revisionBehavior: Validates epoch/revision shape only; ordering is enforced by ProjectionReplica.

functions.name: new
functions.purpose: Create server-owned session authority state from trusted server configuration/providers.

functions.name: getRole
functions.purpose: Return the server-owned session role for the actual Roblox Player.
failureModes: unknown player -> least-privileged role or structured failure
validation: player identity comes from server context

functions.name: canControl
functions.purpose: Resolve whether the actual Roblox Player may currently control the actor id.

functions.name: destroy
functions.purpose: Release session-authority resources and reject later use.

functions.name: new
functions.purpose: Create authoritative in-memory world state with an initial monotonic revision.

functions.name: getSnapshot
functions.purpose: Return a read-only/copy snapshot of current authoritative world state.
functions.revisionBehavior: Returned snapshot includes current revision and cannot mutate owner state.

functions.name: getRevision
functions.purpose: Return the current authoritative world revision.

functions.name: transact
functions.purpose: Apply one server-internal validated mutation atomically against an expected world revision and increment revision exactly once on success.
validation: mutation capability never comes from network payload
functions.revisionBehavior: Reject stale revision; increment exactly once only after successful mutation.

functions.name: new
functions.purpose: Create authorization service from server-owned session and world dependencies.

functions.name: authorize
functions.purpose: Decide command permission without applying gameplay mutation.
validation: command target ids are stable ids
functions.revisionBehavior: May read current revision/context but never increments revision.

functions.name: new
functions.purpose: Create command runtime with validation, authorization, state, and processed-command identity dependencies.

functions.name: register
functions.purpose: Register exactly one server command handler for a stable command type.

functions.name: execute
functions.purpose: Execute an untrusted command through validation, duplicate/revision checks, authorization, registered handler, and structured receipt.
writes: authoritative state only through registered handler/WorldState transaction
sideEffects: may commit one authorized gameplay mutation
functions.revisionBehavior: Mutation commands require expected revision; duplicate commandId returns/reuses safe receipt rather than reapplying mutation.

functions.name: new
functions.purpose: Create Roblox Remote adapter for command ingress with explicit runtime and limit configuration.

functions.name: start
functions.purpose: Bind command Remote ingress, derive actual Player from Roblox, apply coarse limits, and forward accepted input to CommandRuntime.
functions.revisionBehavior: Does not compare or mutate world revision; forwards envelope intact.

functions.name: destroy
functions.purpose: Disconnect Remote bindings and clear transport-only state.

functions.name: new
functions.purpose: Create client command transport with a bounded envelope builder and Roblox transport adapter.
functions.revisionBehavior: Reads current expected revision provider when constructing mutation intent.

functions.name: submit
functions.purpose: Build and submit one bounded client intent and correlate its structured server receipt.
validation: new commandId per logical command unless explicit retry preserves id
functions.revisionBehavior: Mutation intent carries current expected revision; client never advances authoritative revision on its own.

functions.name: destroy
functions.purpose: Cancel/resolve pending client transport work and release transport listeners.

functions.name: new
functions.purpose: Create projection policy service from authoritative world and session authority dependencies.

functions.name: buildForViewer
functions.purpose: Build a viewer-safe projection from authoritative state for the actual server-known viewer.
validation: exclude private/hidden/DM-only data and existence information
functions.revisionBehavior: Projection carries source world/session revision metadata without mutating it.

functions.name: new
functions.purpose: Create projection transport adapter around already viewer-safe projection data.
validation: gateway does not own disclosure rules

functions.name: start
functions.purpose: Bind projection transport lifecycle and any explicit resync request path without disclosure decisions.
sideEffects: binds Roblox Remote listeners if required
functions.revisionBehavior: Never manufactures revision; publishes service-built envelope metadata.

functions.name: publish
functions.purpose: Publish an already viewer-safe projection to the intended actual Player in a bounded ProjectionEnvelope.
functions.revisionBehavior: Must not publish a projection revision older than its own last publication bookkeeping for that epoch/viewer.

functions.name: destroy
functions.purpose: Disconnect projection transport and clear publication-only resources.

functions.name: new
functions.purpose: Create a non-authoritative viewer projection replica with explicit transport source.

functions.name: start
functions.purpose: Subscribe to projection transport and accept only valid non-regressing envelopes.
validation: full resync may replace only according to epoch/revision rules
functions.revisionBehavior: Accept monotonic revisions; reject older revisions; epoch change follows explicit resync contract.

functions.name: getSnapshot
functions.purpose: Return the latest accepted viewer projection as read-only/copy data.

functions.name: subscribe
functions.purpose: Subscribe a client system to immutable projection changes without granting mutation authority.
validation: listener cannot mutate replica through returned data
functions.revisionBehavior: Callbacks observe only accepted monotonic revisions.

functions.name: destroy
functions.purpose: Disconnect projection transport and all subscribers.

functions.name: new
functions.purpose: Create semantic input router with explicit physical input adapter and context provider.
validation: router receives no gameplay mutation dependency

functions.name: subscribe
functions.purpose: Subscribe to a named semantic action rather than raw physical input.

functions.name: start
functions.purpose: Bind physical keyboard/mouse input once and translate it into context-aware semantic actions.
validation: physical input is interpreted but never directly mutates gameplay state

functions.name: destroy
functions.purpose: Disconnect physical input and semantic subscribers.

functions.name: new
functions.purpose: Compose world-facing feature controllers/presenter from semantic input, command, and projection dependencies.
validation: does not accept authoritative state mutator

functions.name: start
functions.purpose: Start registered world controllers/presenter in deterministic dependency order.
validation: partial failure is cleaned up or surfaced fatally

functions.name: destroy
functions.purpose: Destroy world controllers/presenter in safe reverse lifecycle order.

functions.name: new
functions.purpose: Compose server foundation modules and domain registration without embedding their rules.

functions.name: start
functions.purpose: Start server subsystems only after dependencies and command registrations are complete.
validation: partial boot failure surfaces and cleans up

functions.name: destroy
functions.purpose: Destroy server subsystems in safe reverse dependency order.

moduleFunctionContracts.scriptEntrypoint: Resolve ServerApp composition root, construct it, call start(), and report fatal boot failure; no gameplay/transport policy.

functions.name: new
functions.purpose: Compose client input, transport, projection, and world systems without embedding feature behavior.
validation: UI/presenter does not receive direct Remote

functions.name: start
functions.purpose: Start projection/input/world systems in deterministic readiness order with bounded waits.
validation: partial boot failure surfaces and cleans up
functions.revisionBehavior: Initial projection readiness respects projection epoch/revision contract.

functions.name: destroy
functions.purpose: Destroy client subsystems in safe reverse dependency order.

moduleFunctionContracts.scriptEntrypoint: Resolve ClientApp composition root, construct it, call start(), and report fatal boot failure; no gameplay logic.

functions.name: new
functions.purpose: Create selection controller from semantic input, projection, target resolver, and optional change listener dependencies.
functions.revisionBehavior: Selection references actor ids from current accepted projection.

functions.name: start
functions.purpose: Consume semantic Primary actions and update local selection only for currently projected/selectable targets.
functions.revisionBehavior: Selection is revalidated when accepted projection revision changes.

functions.name: getSelection
functions.purpose: Return the current client-local selected actor id.

functions.name: subscribe
functions.purpose: Subscribe presentation/controllers to local selection changes without transferring ownership.
functions.revisionBehavior: Listener observes selection after projection validity checks.

functions.name: destroy
functions.purpose: Disconnect selection input/projection subscriptions and clear subscribers/local state.

functions.name: new
functions.purpose: Create world presenter from projection and client-local presentation state sources only.

functions.name: start
functions.purpose: Render viewer projection and local selection changes into world Instances without gameplay decisions.
validation: only current projection actors are rendered
functions.revisionBehavior: Applies only data from ProjectionReplica accepted revision.

functions.name: destroy
functions.purpose: Disconnect presenter subscriptions and destroy presentation-owned temporary Instances.

functions.name: new
functions.purpose: Create exploration camera controller from semantic input, camera adapter, and projection framing context.

functions.name: start
functions.purpose: Consume semantic camera actions and update local pan/orbit/zoom/framing state.
functions.revisionBehavior: Framing target must exist in current accepted projection when actor-based.

functions.name: destroy
functions.purpose: Disconnect camera input and release camera-owned temporary state.

functions.name: new
functions.purpose: Create movement controller from selection, semantic input, projection, world raycast/path adapters, and CommandClient.
functions.revisionBehavior: Preview is associated with current accepted projection revision.

functions.name: start
functions.purpose: Consume movement semantic actions, maintain local preview, and submit explicit movement intents through CommandClient.
validation: never commit token CFrame as authoritative result
functions.revisionBehavior: Submitted movement carries the projection/world expected revision; preview invalidates on conflicting newer projection.

functions.name: destroy
functions.purpose: Disconnect movement subscriptions and clear preview state.

functions.name: new
functions.purpose: Create context-action controller from semantic input, selection, projection, presentation adapter, and CommandClient.
functions.revisionBehavior: Context candidates derive from current accepted projection.

functions.name: start
functions.purpose: Consume Context/confirm/back semantic actions, resolve viewer-visible action candidates, and submit only explicit chosen intents.
validation: client candidate is not server permission
Q closes one context level according to product input contract
functions.revisionBehavior: Open context invalidates/rebuilds when its source projection revision becomes stale.

functions.name: destroy
functions.purpose: Disconnect context subscriptions and close/clear presentation-only context state.

functions.name: register
functions.purpose: Register movement command semantics with CommandRuntime using server authority and WorldState transaction boundaries.
writes: WorldState only through transaction when handler executes
validation: exploration mode permits requested movement source
functions.revisionBehavior: Handler commits through WorldState.transact using command expected revision.

functions.name: register
functions.purpose: Register exploration interaction command semantics with the standard command/authorization/world-state path.
writes: WorldState only through transaction when interaction mutates
validation: action type valid for current world state
functions.revisionBehavior: Mutating handlers commit through WorldState.transact; read-only interactions do not advance revision.
